name: Scroll Scrub Carousel
description: Stack of titled image carousels where some pin to the screen and scrub sideways with page scroll, while others are swipeable with arrow buttons. Slides fade by distance from center.
contents: Sections list, each with a heading, counter and a row of image slides
Each slide has image, numbered badge, title, description and a link label
behavior: Scrub sections pin in place and move the slides horizontally as the page scrolls, forward or reversed
On touch devices scrub sections become normal swipe carousels
Non-scrub sections slide by drag or arrow buttons
Slides fade by distance from the centered slide
Slides per view change at the mobile breakpoint
editableByProps: Sections, headings, slides, images, text and link label
Scrub on or off and direction per section
Slides per view, gap and side padding for mobile and desktop

needsCodeEdit.change: Change fade range of side slides
needsCodeEdit.where: progress handler inside the Swiper options

needsCodeEdit.change: Change how long each scrub section stays pinned

fixed: Scrub sections pin to the screen and take scroll distance from the page
Slide links are not clickable (pointer events disabled)
Needs swiper stylesheet loaded from the swiper package
Font families are props but no font files are loaded, host must provide them
